items.title: Earl Humphrey Interview, 1963-03-28
items.q: When he couldn't get Ike, he got our bad Glennie. ... Well, we had fun, man. Yeah. We and Albert Glennie and T-boy.

ctx.x: He used to play, uh, bass. Mm-hmm. And then... After then... After then... When he couldn't get Ike, he got our bad Glennie.
